about: A system for building and editing websites, made on top of the Django web framework.

prs.title: A fresh install no longer fails on start
prs.broken: django CMS needs a small helper package to start, but it did not list it as something to install. A clean install crashed at startup with a missing module error.
prs.changed: The helper package is now listed, so installing django CMS brings it in too.
prs.matters: New sites start on the first try, without hunting down a missing package.
